q: How long does the first visit take?
a: About 45 minutes. It includes the initial conversation, a full clinical examination, photographs, any radiographs needed, and the presentation of the treatment plan with its written estimate.

q: Do you accept insurance and health funds?
a: We work with the main supplementary health funds and benefit schemes. Our front desk checks your cover before treatment begins and handles the paperwork for you.

q: How long does treatment with clear aligners take?
a: It depends on the complexity of the case: from 4-6 months for mild alignment to 18-24 months for significant malocclusion. At the first visit, a digital simulation shows the estimated duration for your case.

q: How often should I have a hygiene appointment?
a: For most patients, every six months. Where there is periodontitis, implants or a tendency to build up calculus, recall may be every three or four months: we decide together.
